properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 15 at 8:27PM EDT until August 15 at 9:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
For the following areas...
S of Ocracoke Inlet NC to Cape Lookout NC out to 20 NM...
Waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Cape Lookout NC from 20 to 60 NM...

At 827 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing waterspouts
was located near Atlas Tanker, moving southeast at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts 34 knots or greater, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Atlas Tanker.

lightning, and heavy rain are possible with this storm.

overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
